name: Deep Yellow Limited
content: Deep Yellow Limited is an advanced Australian-based uranium exploration and development company with a primary focus on its projects in Namibia and Australia. The company is strategically positioned to become a significant global uranium producer through the development of its flagship Tumas Project in Namibia and the Mulga Rock Project in Western Australia. Led by an experienced management team with a proven track record in the uranium sector, Deep Yellow is committed to creating long-term shareholder value by executing a dual-pillar growth strategy involving both organic development and inorganic acquisitions.

Officers

John BorshoffOctober 2016

Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Borshoff is an experienced mining executive and geologist with more than 50 years' experience in the uranium industry. He was the founder and CEO of Paladin Energy Ltd. He is a Fellow of the Australian Institute of Company Directors and the AusIMM.

Gillian SwabyOctober 2016

Executive Director

Ms. Swaby has over 35 years' experience in the tertiary education and mining sectors. She has been involved in the uranium industry since 1984. She is a Fellow of the Governance Institute of Australia and the Australian Institute of Company Directors.

Mark PittsFebruary 2010

Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary

Mr. Pitts is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants with more than 30 years' experience in statutory reporting and corporate compliance. He is a Partner in the corporate advisory firm Endeavour Corporate.

Chris SalisburyMay 2021

Director (Non-Executive/Executive Chair)

Mr. Salisbury is a highly experienced mining executive with over 30 years' experience across senior operational and strategic leadership roles. He was previously Chief Executive of Rio Tinto Iron Ore.

Greg Meyerowitz

Non-Executive Director

Mr. Meyerowitz was a senior audit partner at EY for 26 years. He has extensive experience in the resources sector and is a member of the Australian Institute of Company Directors.

Tim McLernonJanuary 2024

Non-Executive Director

Mr. McLernon has over 30 years' experience in the mining industry, specifically in project development and operations. He was previously with Rio Tinto and Paladin Energy.
